normalization: Each instrument uses its own mean; no target normalization or cross-instrument difference.
insufficient_data: RMS is unavailable with fewer than two samples or non-positive mean.
data_scope: Browser slow telemetry, distinct from full-bandwidth FPGA sampling. Readings themselves are not averaged.
reset: Actual target changes/ramps reset both sources. Reconnection, replacement or sample gaps reset only the affected source.

checks: Without a meter: FPGA estimated power and RMS are live; optional meter fields are dashes
Independent readings with different means: steady 20mW meter gives zero RMS while FPGA fluctuates around6mW
Meter replacement resets only meter statistics; own-mean relative RMS is1%, independent of the FPGA target
Target ramp clears both RMS estimates; old step is excluded and new steady samples give zero fluctuation
Disconnecting only the meter clears its readouts while FPGA monitoring continues
Five viewport sizes have no horizontal overflow; desktop first screen includes FPGA power/RMS and target/range/apply
Real device telemetry rendered in final page without any device writes
